amendments.evidence: every complete row's guide gap is 3.3333333338e-07; 18/18 rows rejected at 1e-9, 0/18 rejected for this reason at 1e-6
amendments.original: admit only when native_h3, guide duration equals 56/24 within 1e-9, and prompt length is at least 500 characters
amendments.reason: The frozen 1e-9 value was itself a defect: it compared an ffprobe-rounded measured duration against a plan-declared duration and rejected every recorded row. The production gateway compares measured against declared with AUDIO_DURATION_TOLERANCE_S (1e-6) at predict/content_brief.py:17. This is a declared bug correction made after first results, not a tuned policy.
amendments.unchanged: the primary metric, decision rule, budget, seed and folds were NOT changed by this amendment

decision_polarity: admit only when P(bad) is low; calibrated rows abstain when max(P(bad), 1-P(bad)) < 0.70
decision_rule: insufficient_data if complete<50 or bad<10 or groups<8
not_warranted if no feasible policy or CI does not beat both baselines
label: bad iff whisper_post, vision, or av_sync usable outcome is fail
primary_metric: mean failed-render-attempts avoided per production run at false-admit <= 0.10
transparent_heuristic: admit only when native_h3, guide duration matches 56/24 within AUDIO_DURATION_TOLERANCE_S (1e-6), and prompt length is at least 500 characters
